Refractory Consultancy Services Limited
# Refractory Solutions You Can Trust
Expert refractory installation, inspection, and consultancy services for petrochemical, power generation, cement, and heavy industry worldwide.
[Get in Touch](https://refcsl.co.uk/#contact) [Our Services](https://refcsl.co.uk/#services)
RCSL is a leading provider of refractory installation, supervision, and consultancy services, proudly serving critical industries such as Petrochemical, Power Generation, Incineration, Aluminium, Cement, and Iron/Steel since 2018. Founded by industry veteran Ron Ramsell, we bring over four decades of hands-on expertise to every project.
### Refractory Installation
Brickwork, hand placing, ramming, gunning, and casting across all vessel types and industrial applications.
### Refractory Inspection
API-accredited inspectors with UOP specification compliance ensuring the highest quality standards.
### Refractory Consultancy
Third-party expertise for legal disputes, insurance claims, design evaluations, and material reviews.
### Anchorage Installation
Hexmetal, V-anchors, bullhorn, and ceramic/metallic anchor systems to any specification.

What We Do
## Our Services
Comprehensive refractory solutions for the world's most demanding industrial environments.
Inspection
### Refractory Inspection
Conducted by highly trained inspectors conversant with UOP and API standards. We provide thorough inspections of refractory linings in reactors, regenerators, cyclones, transfer lines, and associated equipment. Our inspectors are fully accredited and experienced with ASTM and API material specifications, ensuring all installations meet the highest quality and safety standards.
![Refractory inspection inside process vessel](https://refcsl.co.uk/assets/worker-inspection-vessel.jpg)
Installation
### Refractory Installation
Complete refractory installation services covering brickwork, hand placing, ramming, gunning, and casting. We work with all types of refractory materials including firebrick, castable, ceramic fibre board, and insulation systems. Our teams have completed installations in FCCUs, hydrocrackers, rotary kilns, incinerators, biomass plants, and waste heat boilers worldwide.
![Rotary kiln brick lining — interior view](https://refcsl.co.uk/assets/kiln-brick-lining-interior.jpg)
Consultancy
### Refractory Consultancy
Specialized third-party expertise for legal disputes, insurance claims, design evaluations, and material specification reviews. Our consultancy services are built on decades of practical experience, providing independent assessments that are trusted by refineries, plant operators, and legal professionals alike.
![RCSL team with RHI Magnesita during inspection](https://refcsl.co.uk/assets/team-rhi-magnesita.jpg)
Anchorage
### Anchorage Installation
Professional installation of refractory anchor systems including hexmetal (hexmesh), V-anchors, bullhorn anchors, and ceramic/metallic anchor systems. We fabricate and install anchorage to any specification, with expert welding services for all anchor types in any vessel configuration.
![Hexmesh anchor welding in FCCU](https://refcsl.co.uk/assets/hexmesh-welding-sparks.jpg)

About Us
## Excellence in Refractory Solutions Worldwide
### Our Mission
RCSL delivers expert refractory solutions with precision, quality, and global reliability. We combine four decades of hands-on experience with a commitment to safety, quality workmanship, and client satisfaction.
![Ron Ramsell — Managing Director of RCSL, wearing PPE with helmet](https://refcsl.co.uk/assets/ron-ramsell.jpg)
### Ron Ramsell
Managing Director & Founder
Ron Ramsell is the founder and Managing Director of RCSL, bringing over 40 years of industry expertise. A time-served sheet metal worker and welder, Ron began his career at North Kent Engineering in 1978, earning his City & Guilds qualifications (C&G 200, C&G 165 Parts 1-3).
Over the decades, Ron has managed some of the most complex refractory turnarounds in the petrochemical industry, specialising in FCCU reactors, regenerators, hydrocrackers, and transfer line systems. He has led teams of up to 110 workers and completed projects across more than 20 countries.

## REFRACTORY CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED Overview
Refractory Consultancy Services Limited is concerned with construction and maintenance of the relevant equipment in the following industries: Aluminium, Cement, Iron/Steel, Incineration, Petrochemical/Oil and Gas and Power Generation. My company has taken on a number of high-profile contracts since its inception to name a few: • FCCU Turnaround at ENI Oil Refinery in Sannazzaro. (April 2018) • FCCU Turnaround at Lukoil Nizhny Novgorod, two FCCUs overhauled concurrently. (September – November 2018) • Blast Furnace Maintenance at Pinnacle Power’s New Biomass Power Plant in Nottingham. (March 2019) • Incineration Unit Overhaul at DSTL’s Porton Down location. (April 2019) • Blast Furnace Complete Lining Replacement at Pinnacle Power’s New Biomass Power Plant in Nottingham. (May – June 2019) • FCCU Turnaround Welding Subcontractor at TOTAL’s Lindsay Oil Refinery. (May – August 2019) • Waste Heat Boiler Repairs at ADM Pura Food’s food processing plant. (August 2019) • Standby Boiler Complete Brickwork Replacement at ADM Pura Food’s food processing Plant. (October 2019) • FCCU Inspection during turnaround at RAM Milazzo Refinery in Sicily (October – November 2019) We specialise in FCCU work with unrivalled experience for all licensors. We offer a thorough, detailed inspection process with high-quality reports and informed, fair decision making. Alternatively, we have constructed and maintained them using our team of highly skilled craftsmen. We have a division of ASME IX or equivalent coded welders which undertake all types of welded fabrications predominately for industrial and construction sectors, from large structural fabrications to gantries, stairways and all supporting structures. With regards to refractory anchorage we aim to provide a full package for refractory repairs and construction therefore our company has obtained the procedures to weld the relevant metal pairings required within our industries, our welders are also qualified to these procedures.
